newsitem.title: USA: Boston Chicken plans up to 600 Asia stores.
newsitem.headline: Boston Chicken plans up to 600 Asia stores.

text.p: Boston Market International Inc, a new company formed to franchise Boston Market stores outside the U.S., said it signed a letter of intent to open up to 600 stores in Taiwan and China over the next 10 years.
The company said it is the first time Boston Market stores will expand outside the United States.

The letter of intent is with John Sun, a restaurant developer and operator with experience bringing American restaurants to Southeast Asia. The new Taiwan-based company will be funded with about $20 million in equity capital from John Sun and other private investors and a $60 million convertible loan from Boston Market. Boston will have the option to convert its loan into a mamority equity interest in the Taiwan company at a later date.
The company said it was also continuing with its plan to open another 300 to 350 stores in the U.S. in 1977.
The transactions are subject to execution of definitive agreements, which is expected during the first quarter of 1997.
